pkgmetadata.longdescription: BlastEm is a fast and highly accurate emulator of the Sega Genesis/Mega Drive, with support for the Sega/Mega CD, 32X, Pico, Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000/SC-3000 and ColecoVision. It uses a dynamic recompiler for the 68000 and Z80, has a Nuklear-based GUI, a debugger and a GDB remote stub.

use.flag: Use the GTK+ 3 file chooser (loaded at run time) instead of the built-in one
